1. (Currently amended) A cosmetic composition comprising an indole compound of formula I:

[formula I structure]

wherein R1, R2, R3, R4, R5, R6, R7, R8, R9, R10, R11 and R12 are independently selected from hydrogen, halogen, alkyl, alkoxy, aryl, heteroaryl, or combinations thereof, and/or a physiologically acceptable salt thereof, __for treating skin diseases which are associated with defective keratinisation relating to differentiation and cell proliferation__.

2. (Cancelled)

3. (Currently amended) Composition for topical use comprising a) the active ingredient according to Claim 1, b) one or more skin-tolerated vehicles, and c) optionally one or more further active compounds having a skin-care and/or inflammation-inhibiting action, __wherein the composition is formulated for treating skin diseases which are associated with defective keratinisation__.

4. (Currently amended) Composition according to Claim 1 or 3, wherein the active ingredient is contained in said composition in an amount of 0.00001 per cent by weight to 10 per cent by weight __for treating acne vulgaris__.

5. (Currently amended) Composition according to claim 1, comprising as a further skin-care ingredient ectoine __in an amount of 0.01 to 10 per cent by weight for treating skin diseases associated with defective keratinisation__.

6. (Cancelled)

7. (Currently amended) Use of the active ingredient of Claim 1 for the manufacture of a cosmetic composition __for treating skin diseases which are associated with defective keratinisation relating to differentiation and cell proliferation__.

8. (Currently amended) Use of the active ingredient of Claim 1 for the preparation of a composition which is suitable for the treatment of skin diseases which are associated with defective keratinisation relating to differentiation and cell proliferation, __specifically__ for the treatment of acne vulgaris, acne comedonica, polymorphic acne, acne rosaceae, nodular acne, acne conglobata, age-related acne, acne occurring as a side effect, such as acne solaris, medicament-related acne or acne professionalis, for the treatment of other defects of keratinisation, __specifically__ ichthyosis, ichthyosiform states, Darier's disease, keratosis palmo-plantaris, leukoplakia, leukoplakiform states, skin and mucosal (buccal) eczema (lichen), for the treatment of other skin diseases which are associated with defective keratinisation and have an inflammatory and/or immunoallergic component, and __specifically__ all forms of psoriasis relating to the skin, mucous membranes and finger- and toenails, and psoriatic rheumatism and skin atopy, such as eczema, or respiratory atopy, or also hypertrophy of the gums.

9. (Currently amended) Use according to Claim 8 for hair care and/or hair follicle development __in the treatment of hair conditions associated with defective keratinisation__.

10. (Currently amended) Use of the active ingredient of Claim 1 for the care, preservation or improvement of the general state of the skin or hair __in the treatment of skin diseases which are associated with defective keratinisation__.

11. (Original)

12. (Currently amended) Use of the composition according to Claim 1 for skin lightening and/or skin whitening __in the treatment of pigmentation disorders associated with defective keratinisation__.

13. (Currently amended) Use of the active ingredient of Claim 1 for the [[prophylaxis against or]] reduction of skin unevenness, such as wrinkles, fine lines, rough skin or large-pored skin __associated with defective keratinisation__.

14. (Currently amended) Use of the active ingredient of Claim 1 for the [[prophylaxis against]] __treatment of__ time- and/or light-induced ageing processes of the human skin or human hair, __specifically__ for [[prophylaxis against]] __treatment of__ dry skin, wrinkle formation and/or pigment defects, and/or for the reduction [[or prevention]] of the harmful effects of UV rays on the skin __in conditions associated with defective keratinisation__.
